chapter_seo_title: A Mortal's Journey – The High Rollers Gather at Void Heaven Palace
chapter_meta_description: The Nascent Soul heavyweights arrive: righteous vs demonic standoff inside the Void Heaven Palace. Han Li is humbled by a legendary brute. Cold war, not open war.
og_title: Void Heaven Palace: The Titans Clash
og_description: Extreme Yin, Wan Tianming, and the infamous Man Brutal Beard face off in a battle of glares and grudges. Han Li learns his place.
twitter_title: When Nascent Soul monsters play politics
twitter_description: Han Li gets kicked off his seat by a legendary brute. Welcome to the high-stakes meeting of the Chaotic Star Sea.

lore_anchors.definition: A floating jade palace that appears periodically in the Chaotic Star Sea; it is a sealed ruin from an ancient era, filled with treasures, traps, and deadly restrictions. Only those with the correct map-token can enter.
The legendary ultimate treasure sealed deep within the Void Heaven Palace; said to be powerful enough to reshape the cultivation world’s balance.
A major righteous path sect in the Chaotic Star Sea, led by Wan Tianming.
Man Brutal Beard’s signature demonic technique, claimed to be the strongest defensive art in the Chaotic Star Sea.
The condensed spiritual avatar formed after Core Formation; Nascent Soul cultivators represent the apex of power in the mortal realm, capable of surviving even the destruction of their physical body.
A rare spirit fruit said to extend a cultivator’s natural lifespan; Man Brutal Beard is rumored to be after it.
A major demonic path sect in the Chaotic Star Sea, ruled by Extreme Yin.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Han Li fight back when Man Brutal Beard kicked him off the pillar?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he had no idea whether the hall’s restrictions would stop a Nascent Soul brute. Picking that fight would have been suicide, not bravery. Mortal Stream survival: swallow pride, live to retreat another day.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Extreme Yin go silent when Wan Tianming arrives?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Extreme Yin is early Nascent Soul; Wan Tianming is likely mid-Nascent Soul or late—a tier gap that makes direct confrontation extremely dangerous. Extreme Yin chooses to conserve face rather than lose it openly.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Void Heaven Cauldron?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s the ultimate sealed treasure inside the Void Heaven Palace, powerful enough that even Nascent Soul old monsters scheme over it. Its exact abilities are legendary and unclear, which makes it all the more dangerous.
